'''Modigliani''' is an NPC located in {{Location|City Square|nocat=1}}. He can be found near a small fountain alongside a Primordia Bloom.

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Modigliani:''' Go ahead, eat up. Let's see if you can grow into even more vibrant colors.
:{{DIcon}} What are you doing?
:'''Modigliani:''' I have a habit of taking care of these Primordia Blooms. Be careful. They can release hallucinogenic toxins.
:'''Modigliani:''' Since we from [[Fisalia Family|Fisalia]] grew up around their venom, we're not affected by it, but it's safer for anyone untrained to stay away.
:{{DIcon}} They do look beautiful.
:'''Modigliani:''' Dangerous things always seem to know how to draw attention. The illusions they create can be so captivating that they make people forget their everyday worries.
:'''Modigliani:''' Much like the emotions stirred by theater, wealth, and status—each is but a fleeting illusion.
:{{DIcon}} That's an interesting perspective...
:'''Modigliani:''' Unfortunately, the sober-minded are always the minority. Most people from the Fisalia district are weighed down by outdated honors, unable to break free from our past.
:'''Modigliani:''' They constantly mention how Fisalia was instrumental in founding Ragunna and the Order of the Deep.
:'''Modigliani:''' But now, we've put away our cold swords and let go of our vigilant ways.
:'''Modigliani:''' As time goes on, what does Fisalia have left, aside from empty pride?
:'''Modigliani:''' Just a facade of mystery and intrigue, perhaps. It's the last refuge for many from Fisalia—a flimsy cover for our flaws.
{{Dialogue End}}
